source: Digimon Story: Time Stranger - Unique Digimon Chats

entries.opening:
Make sure you look after me, okay? Otherwise, I just might 
have to play my pipes here...

exchanges.tamer: Wanna try controlling me with them?
exchanges.digimon: I dunno... For some reason, I get the feeling it wouldn't work...
Actually... I don't know. Everyone hears them differently.

exchanges.tamer: Don't worry. I'll watch over you.
exchanges.digimon: ...Yeah, you're right. I know you'll take good care of me.

Even without playing my pipes...? Wow, thanks! I'll take 
good care of you, too.

entries.opening: Where do ya wanna go? If I can go there, I'll take ya!

exchanges.tamer: Somewhere no one's ever been to before.
exchanges.digimon: You wanna go on an adventure? A brave request... but, okay!

exchanges.tamer: Somewhere I don't know about yet.
exchanges.digimon:
The world's a big place, huh? Bet we can learn lots by 
going to different places!

Hehe. It's kinda embarrassing when ya say it out loud... 
but I feel the same way!

exchanges.tamer: A place where you can rest.
exchanges.digimon: Hehe. Thanks. Just you saying that gives me strength!

entries.opening:
Now that I can shoot lightning, you might get shocked 
if you touch me.

exchanges.tamer: I'm not afraid of a little shock.
exchanges.digimon:
You really are a brave one, huh? I could learn a few things 
from you.

And that would protect you from lightning? Huh. You learn 
something new every day.

exchanges.tamer: You'd never do anything mean like that.
exchanges.digimon:
Haha. There's no fooling you, huh? Yeah, don't worry. 
I'd never shock you.
Wow, listen to you! What a character you are! Hehe!

entries.opening: My left hand is so big now... Are you scared of me?

exchanges.digimon:
Aw, I was hoping you'd be at least a little spooked... But thanks. 
I'm glad I asked.

exchanges.tamer: No, but it is pretty interesting.
exchanges.digimon:
Oh... I guess I do have more to learn, too... about myself, 
and how to protect everyone.

exchanges.tamer: More like reassured that I can count on you.
exchanges.digimon:
Really? Hehe. Well, I'm counting on you, too. Let's use this 
hand of mine to save everyone!

What?! R-Really? Now I'm feeling kinda self-conscious.
Hehe...

entries.opening:
The other day, I saw a flower garden full of roses. 
It was really beautiful.

exchanges.tamer: Let's make weapons out of all the thorns.
exchanges.digimon:
Haha. Like the ones I have? True. These thorns do pack a 
prickly sting!

exchanges.tamer: Let's gather the petals for a bath.
exchanges.digimon:
You mean put the petals in the water? Huh. I never thought 
of using them that way.
Sure, I'd love to! And I'm gonna hold you to that promise!

exchanges.tamer: I'd like to give all the roses to you.
exchanges.digimon:
Um, would that really suit me...? Still, that's very nice 
of you to say. Thanks.

entries.opening: I think I wanna do something mean to you.

exchanges.tamer: Be mean to me and I'll be mean back.
exchanges.digimon: Figured you'd say that. You're ready for anything, aren't you?

I'm not telling. Besides, I can't just come up with these things 
outta nowhere, you know.

Doing it even if you say not to is the whole point. But I guess 
I can skip it for today...

Trying to talk me out of it? Sorry, but once you catch my eye, 
it's gonna happen.

entries.opening: Is your heart pure?

exchanges.digimon:
You might be joking, but I suggest you mend your ways. 
I cannot abide an impure heart.

exchanges.tamer: It might be a little impure.
exchanges.digimon:
Very honest of you. But think carefully. If you feel that way, 
purity is not far off.

So you have some doubt within you? I shall help you rid 
yourself of this uncertainty.
A bold claim. But do not worry. I believe you.

entries.opening: Which do you prefer, birds or fish?

exchanges.digimon:
Are you perhaps not a fan of me? Once you hear my song, 
I bet you'll change your tune.

A fan of the sea? You'll be happy to know it feels incredible 
to sing in the ocean depths.

Then I imagine you'll like my peculiar look. I feel like singing 
a song, just for you!

In that case, allow me to serenade you from the skies with 
my avian trill.

entries.opening: How about it? Coming aboard?

exchanges.tamer: I bet I'd get motion sickness.
exchanges.digimon:
I'd strive to keep turbulence to a minimum, so please 
overcome your trepidation.

exchanges.tamer: I don't do well with smoke.
exchanges.digimon:
I'm really careful with humans on board. I wouldn't blow 
too much smoke, you know.

exchanges.tamer: Can you take me somewhere nearby?
exchanges.digimon: Near or far, I promise you a smooth and pleasant journey.

exchanges.tamer: Let's travel to the ends of the earth!
exchanges.digimon:
Very well. It'll be a long journey for sure, so I won't slack off 
on the maintenance.

entries.opening: I must inflict divine punishment upon those who commit evil deeds.

exchanges.tamer: Sounds a little harsh to me...
exchanges.digimon:
I imagine those receiving the punishment feel the same. 
That is why I judge carefully.

exchanges.tamer: I say condemn the offense, not the offender.
exchanges.digimon: But of course. I always judge good and evil without sentiment.
As well you should. I do hope you never end up being judged.

exchanges.tamer: I wish you didn't have to.
exchanges.digimon:
Perhaps I feel similar. Nothing would please me more than 
if my duty was no longer needed.

entries.opening: Have my emotions bubbled to the surface?

exchanges.tamer: Too much, if you ask me.
exchanges.digimon:
Clearly, your judgment is off. I calmly judge the need for severe 
punishment, nothing more.

I understand if you think so. Still, calmly talking like this is 
proof of my composure.
It seems you understand the dispassion of my rage.
Precisely! It seems you understand the composure behind my wrath.

entries.opening: I'm willing to go to any lengths to achieve victory.

exchanges.digimon:
My victories defend the peace of the Digital World. I could 
really use your help, too!

exchanges.tamer: Sometimes you have to lose to win.
exchanges.digimon:
I'm defending the Digital World here, so your logic doesn't jive. 
Victory is everything.

Please understand that if it means saving the Digital World,
I'm prepared to break any rule.

exchanges.tamer: Win or lose, it's best to try to get along.
exchanges.digimon:
Maybe when it comes to you, but some in this world can only 
be stopped with force.

entries.opening: I am not suited for a throne.

exchanges.digimon: That is hardly something for a human to jest about. Foolhardy, indeed.

It may appear that way to you, but the vagabond life suits me. 
It has much to offer.

Even if that were true, I am your ally now. I have no time to 
attend to a throne.

exchanges.tamer: Hand it to someone else, then?
exchanges.digimon:
Sure, if I meet someone worthy of it. Perhaps they will cross 
our path on this journey.

entries.opening: We must protect the beautiful seas.

exchanges.digimon:
Feelings are certainly important, but we need action. Not that 
I have to tell you that.
There is much for us to do. Shall we mull over the matter together?

That is reassuring. Surely a bright future awaits us, with the 
help of humanity.

exchanges.tamer: You should leave it to me.
exchanges.digimon:
I appreciate the sentiment, but this is my duty. But yes, let us 
work together.

entries.opening: Spending time with a human isn't too shabby.

exchanges.tamer: You may think so for now.
exchanges.digimon:
My, is that right? Well, if you have another side to show me, 
hurry up and do it already.

Not at all! I enjoy learning about your daily routine. Here's to 
learning even more!

exchanges.tamer: Aren't you just saying that to be polite?
exchanges.digimon:
You're the one being standoffish and overly polite. Let's just 
be real with each other.

I intend to do just that, of course. I can't imagine myself away 
from you at this point.

entries.opening: You have some growing up to do.

exchanges.digimon:
Just thinking it won't achieve anything. Keep a level head and 
take it one step at a time.

Can't you? I don't mean physical maturity, but mental. It's 
all a matter of attitude.

exchanges.tamer: Don't treat me like a kid.
exchanges.digimon:
Can you say with confidence that you're more grown-up than 
me? Something tells me no.

Saying that just proves you're still a kid. Still, I like your 
innocent, childish side.

entries.opening: Am I hot?

exchanges.digimon:
Perhaps I lack zeal? It seems I must redouble my training
regimen.

It must be the hot blood boiling in my veins, though I do try 
to rein it in.

In light of my role as a deity, I suppose I should take that as a 
compliment. My thanks.

I apologize if the heat is uncomfortable, but I must not let my 
fervor as a deity waver.

entries.opening: Am I... cold?

exchanges.digimon:
Well, be forewarned, because there are times when I can be
perceived as such.

Surely not all the time, though? It must seem that way because
I shoot arrows of ice...

Is that what you think?! I embrace others with a warm heart at
times, you know!

Is that how I look? That can't be helped, but please take note
of my other side as well.

entries.opening: Grr...! I'm so busy I don't have enough hands to deal with it all!

exchanges.tamer: Well, now you're just being greedy.
exchanges.digimon:
I never have enough to do my best work, but I am certainly
blessed. Better put 'em to work.

exchanges.tamer: Those should be more than enough.
exchanges.digimon:
True. Eight might work with the right design. Better put my 
nose to the grindstone.

exchanges.tamer: Shall I lend you a hand?
exchanges.digimon:
Friendship's all I really need. With eight limbs, I'll pay it back 
four times over!

exchanges.tamer: How many more do you even need?
exchanges.digimon:
The more the merrier, if you ask me! Still, you're good with the 
two you've got, right?

entries.opening: I will never miss a single move you make.

exchanges.tamer: Thanks. Keep a close eye on me!
exchanges.digimon:
Certainly. But bear in mind that I see all—what lies on the surface, 
and within.

Whether I intend to look at you or not, I observe everything there
is to see about you.

exchanges.tamer: Do you have to stare so intently?
exchanges.digimon:
I promise I am not staring. However, know that I am always
watching over you.

Perceiving you with my mind, as opposed to my eyes, allows
me to see the true you.

entries.opening: Tell me what kind of fruit you like!

exchanges.digimon:
Wine from such fruit makes me drunk on the scent alone... 
I get quite generous as well!

Such fruit makes mellow brews when fermented. 
I'd love to try a few out!

I love the crisp acidity of wines from such fruit. Let's have a 
drinking contest!

Wines from juicy fruit are tangy and go down easy, especially 
with a good story!

entries.opening: Am I... the jealous type?

exchanges.tamer: Not at all. You're compassionate and kind.
exchanges.digimon:
I am honored you think so highly of me. I shall have to keep 
my jealousy in check...

It is a relief to hear that. Still, I wonder what your basis 
for saying that is...

That response only worries me more. Still, I appreciate 
your kindness.
I see... I shall be careful not to get too attached to you.

entries.opening: What is wrong with being jealous?

exchanges.digimon:
Then I shall surrender to this yearning. Please keep your 
eyes fixed upon me.

exchanges.tamer: It's a waste of your beauty.
exchanges.digimon:
But consider this. If you cannot meet the person you love, what
is the point of beauty?
At the very least, I shall be careful not to cause you any trouble.

exchanges.tamer: It makes everyone pull away from you.
exchanges.digimon:
I fear that is unavoidable. Keep your eyes on me, exposed 
for all to see.

entries.opening: Is there nowhere I can enjoy a captivating singing voice?

exchanges.digimon:
I suppose not... But I shall not give up, so please help me
search.

exchanges.tamer: Why not search from the sky?
exchanges.digimon:
I intend to do so, naturally. Let us listen together from the
heavens!

exchanges.tamer: Want me to sing for you?
exchanges.digimon:
I appreciate the thought, but I seek a truly captivating voice, 
not merely human singing.
I thank you. We shall soar the wide heavens together.

entries.opening: Are you not hungry?

exchanges.digimon:
Take the blessings of Gaia with gratitude. Collect too many
and disaster may strike.

Yes, you seemed as though you might be. So this is how a 
contented human looks.

I have the fruits of Karpos Hulē here, but they may not suit 
the human palate.

Poor thing. Were you a Digimon, I could help, but I am afraid 
I can do nothing. Forgive me.

entries.opening: Are you afraid of me?

exchanges.digimon:
Too much flattery will be your ruin. Horror and violence ought 
to be feared properly.

If you lack sin or evil worthy of the underworld, you have 
nothing to fear from me.

Of the underworld? I would not send a human like you to that 
realm in the first place.

exchanges.tamer: I'm not scared, but you're a fearsome sight.
exchanges.digimon:
Though both human and Digimon would agree, an ally is an ally. 
You shall not be my prey.

entries.opening: Are there any fresh, juicy DigiCores around here?

exchanges.digimon:
I hardly expected that response... It seems you are prepared to
gaze into the abyss with me.

Your friends appear to have some nice DigiCores...
But I suppose you, a human, were not the one to ask.

exchanges.tamer: Even if there were, I wouldn't tell you.
exchanges.digimon:
Teasing me, are you? Your friends will end up forfeit at this rate.
But for now, training.

I suppose I must forbear, now that we are allies.
Take me on a trip so that I might at least forget such things.

entries.opening: Have you any interest in traveling the galaxy?

exchanges.digimon:
Set your thoughts racing to new worlds, and once day your
dreams will become reality.

exchanges.tamer: What kind of place is it?
exchanges.digimon:
The superspace within me is difficult to describe, but it will show 
you new worlds.

The galaxy of the Digital World may differ from that of your own,
but I shall aid you.

So you say, but I, myself, am a galaxy. Thus, you have already
set forth on the journey.

entries.opening: Think you can keep up with my super speed?

exchanges.digimon:
Glad to hear it, because racing around the Net all alone
gets boring. Now, let's go!

exchanges.tamer: Where are you in such a hurry to go?
exchanges.digimon:
I want to go from one end of the Net to the other and show you
the entire Digital World!

Then clear the way. I don't want to crash into you and smash
you to smithereens.

Speed is everything to a machine. I'm only going to get faster,
so you better keep up!

entries.opening: Combat is a cruel, painful thing.

exchanges.digimon:
Seems your resolve is steeled. Now that we are comrades, 
our hearts and minds are one.

The battle to purge evil is unavoidable, but I would be happy 
to hear any plan you have.

You, too, have seen your fair share of carnage. I would like to 
hear your stories someday.

I suggest you drop the bluster. Instead, allow me to support 
the needs of your heart.

entries.opening: I'm crazy tough, huh? So are all my pals!

exchanges.tamer: You're good at running and hiding.
exchanges.digimon:
...Wh-What?! Maybe you haven't heard, but it takes guts to know 
when to run for it!

Say whatever ya want! Me and my pals are just fightin' smart, 
that's all!

Then just be glad we're on the same side. I always look out for 
my friends.

If that's what ya think, then keep me safe. I mean, we're pals, 
right? Right?

entries.opening: What? I look pissed? I'm in a great mood, I tell ya!

exchanges.tamer: All I can see is an angry mug.
exchanges.digimon:
I'm in the best mood when I'm pissed! Rile me up more and 
I'll send somebody flyin'!

Dummy! This ain't no time for a ditty! I fight tough guys when 
I'm in a good mood!
Right? I'm so happy, it's infuriatin'! I wanna send some joker flyin'!

I AM smilin', dangit! What do ya think this is comin' outta my 
face, a long sneeze?!

entries.opening: You workin' out?

exchanges.digimon:
How 'bout swingin' around a bone club like me? That'll put some 
muscle on ya.

exchanges.tamer: I wanna work out with you.
exchanges.digimon:
Ya ain't on my level, kid. Humans gotta work out human-style. 
Ya get me? Think about it.

Don't look that way, but I guess it ain't fair to compare anybody 
with my jacked bod.

Then how're ya gonna defend yourself? But meh. Ain't like I wouldn't 
jump in to help.

entries.opening: Hey, pal, youse shakin' from the chill?

exchanges.digimon:
How about youse and me have a li'l throwdown? My Snow Punch's 
got a spicy bite to it.

exchanges.tamer: I'm cold, but I'm not shaking.
exchanges.digimon:
Then lemme tell ya somethin' nice. Runnin' wild like me gets
yer blood pumpin'!

exchanges.tamer: I don't mind it being a little nippy.
exchanges.digimon:
Nice, nice. How about youse put ice on yer shoulders like me? 
It makes good weapons.

exchanges.tamer: Of course! This cold is bone-chilling.
exchanges.digimon:
What a lazybones. Why not take a jog, warm up yer body? I'll
even join ya fer a few laps.

entries.opening:
You're always real good to me. Hehe. Guess that means you're
a fan of mine!

exchanges.tamer: Acting too full of yourself will make me mad.
exchanges.digimon:
Ooh, sooo scary! But this isn't what you're really like when you're 
mad, is it?

exchanges.tamer: But what if I have some ulterior motive?
exchanges.digimon:
Huh? I didn't think about that... Hmm. Why exactly are you so
good to me?

Hehe. Well, I'll leave it at that... But no reason not to do my best
for my partner!

Uh, yeah... Thanks. It's kinda embarrassing when you just come
out and say it like that.

entries.opening: The bones of the defeated are mine to claim.

exchanges.digimon:
Just erasing the fallen may be more merciful, but it is my duty 
to collect their grudges.

exchanges.tamer: Sounds like a nice memorial service.
exchanges.digimon:
Oh? I take possession of the fallen's grudges forever. 
Surely there is no greater disgrace.

exchanges.tamer: What do you do that for?
exchanges.digimon:
Data remains in their bones. By collecting them, I—we, 
really—inherit their grudges.

exchanges.tamer: That sounds like quite a chore.
exchanges.digimon:
I do not need your pity, human. If you must, pity the grudges 
left behind in these bones.

entries.opening: I wish to be free... Free from all forms of control.

exchanges.digimon:
So I must not give up hope, even though I do not know when 
that day will arrive...?
Very true. All I can do is bear this in mind...

Is that how you perceive it? Perhaps it is a matter of how I 
view things...

I am afraid you are only trying to console me, but your support 
is appreciated.

entries.opening: Do you believe in fate, or perhaps destiny?

exchanges.digimon: Then resist until the very end. I shall do all I can to assist you.

If you harbor doubts, let things come as they will.
I shall watch over you until the end.
Believing is easy. But it also brings pain. Be prepared for that.

And what will you do about this? If you intend to resist, 
I would like to help.

entries.opening: I wish I could swim for longer periods of time in the deep ocean...

exchanges.digimon: I guess I'll never learn how if I don't try, right? Okay, I'll go for it, then!

exchanges.tamer: Let's come up with a strategy.
exchanges.digimon:
Yeah, let's look up what makes it possible. I'm ready to do it 
by the book!

Special training? Like, something I do on my own? I sure wish 
you'd join me.

exchanges.tamer: I'll watch you while you try.
exchanges.digimon:
I'm a little scared to try alone, so I'll be glad to have you there. 
Okay, let's do it!

entries.opening: What can I do to get better at singing?

exchanges.tamer: Keep practicing, just like you've been doing!
exchanges.digimon:
I figured I couldn't improve overnight. Thanks a bunch! I'll keep 
up the hard work!

exchanges.tamer: Why not go to a concert?
exchanges.digimon: That's a good idea! Hearing others sing is important, too!

exchanges.tamer: I'll join you if you wanna practice.
exchanges.digimon: Oh, boy! That's super nice of you! Let's sing a duet, just you and me!
I see what you mean! Singing's more than just skill. It's heart!

entries.opening: I wonder... What's the most charming thing about me?

exchanges.digimon:
Yeah! I'm so cute, you'd never imagine I could throw down. 
You really get me, huh!

exchanges.tamer: Your tactics that throw your foes off!
exchanges.digimon: A-yup. Battle starts from your noggin! And I'm all noggin!

exchanges.tamer: That shell that protects my little friend!
exchanges.digimon: Yeah? I thought as much! This shell of mine is pretty fine.

exchanges.tamer: The fact that you're a real cutie patootie!
exchanges.digimon: Hehehe... You're embarrassing me, here. Thanks, though.

entries.opening: Fishy, fishy, fish-fish! *sigh* I wanna eat some fish...

exchanges.digimon: You betcha, I will! And after I catch a bunch, I'll give you some, too!

Wouldn't it be faster if I just caught 'em? But maybe I should
give the easy way a try.
That's what I wanted to hear! We're gonna catch a ton of fishies!

exchanges.tamer: Want me to go find some?
exchanges.digimon:
Thanks. That really makes me happy! Let's find some together
and then eat 'em!

entries.opening: Hey, let's play that human game, rock-paper-scissors! One, two...

exchanges.digimon: Dang it! I lost... But I won in spirit!

exchanges.tamer: How about this...? The unbeatable hand!
exchanges.digimon:
W-Wow! You did rock, paper and scissors all at once! I've still
got lots to learn...

exchanges.tamer: I'll go for a draw... Scissors!
exchanges.digimon: Hey, you did scissors, just like me! That means we're friends!

exchanges.tamer: Guess I'll let you win... Paper!
exchanges.digimon: I won! Yay! But... I know what you did... Thanks, anyway.

entries.opening:
I need a makeover... What should I change to give me that 
wow factor?

exchanges.tamer: Swap out your helmet for a new one!
exchanges.digimon:
I see. I ought to be brave enough to change the stuff that stands 
out the most!

exchanges.tamer: Why not start by reading a fashion magazine?
exchanges.digimon:
A fashion mag...? Huh. Like a book that shows you the latest 
duds? Sounds interesting!

exchanges.tamer: I'll make you some new clothes.
exchanges.digimon:
You'd do all that? For little ol' me? You have no idea how happy 
that makes me!

exchanges.tamer: You're fabulous the way you are.
exchanges.digimon:
Aw, shucks... Thanks. I mean it. Don't mind the blushing 
and everything...

entries.opening: My tail... Me, proud. Must get stronger!

exchanges.digimon: Of course! But me, happy you say that...

exchanges.tamer: Why not develop a new move?
exchanges.digimon: A new move... Yes, cool. You, help me think...?
Train together... That sound fun. Me, happy...

exchanges.tamer: The red on the tip of your tail is cool.
exchanges.digimon: Yes! Red part, cool! You... understand good!

entries.opening: Arrr! 'ave ye spied any fancy booty as o' late?

exchanges.tamer: I wouldn't mind a treasure hunt.
exchanges.digimon:
Aye, a search fraught with peril. May we find lands the likes 
o' which ne'er been seen.

exchanges.tamer: Why not read an old tome?
exchanges.digimon:
Yo ho! Perhaps we may find knowledge within o' plunder what 
been squirreled away.

exchanges.tamer: Let's go look for some together!
exchanges.digimon:
Well, ain't ye a sight for sore eyes! One's luck only grows 
among mates—as do the mirth!

Blow me down! I 'adn't thought o' that. Ye done pleased this 
ole sea dog beyond measure.

entries.opening: *sigh* Gotta get me some new tunes to get this heart thumpin'...

exchanges.tamer: Maybe you should make your own.
exchanges.digimon: I never thought of that! My own tracks... Now, that'd be hype!

exchanges.tamer: Why not hit up the clubs?
exchanges.digimon:
Now you're talkin'! Nothin' beats bein' there right in the middle 
of the music!
You'd sing just for me? That'd be hella cool!

A life without music ain't worth livin'! Gotta keep the tunes
bumpin' every day!

entries.opening: Ho, boy... My tummy doesn't feel right...

exchanges.tamer: Why not gulp down some water?
exchanges.digimon:
Oh, I see! If I ate something funny, I could flush it out with a nice, 
big swallow, huh?

exchanges.tamer: Should we check for a stomach bug?
exchanges.digimon:
Better to check than to try and deal with it blindly, for sure.
Good call!

exchanges.tamer: Should I take a look inside your stomach?
exchanges.digimon:
What? You'd be willing to go in there? For me? How thoughtful
of you... Thank you.

exchanges.tamer: Aw, that's too bad... But I'm here for you!
exchanges.digimon:
Those words ease the pain better than any medicine could.
Thank you for your kindness.

entries.opening: My blade... amazing... Kehehe.

exchanges.digimon: You... get it. Blade, strong! Blade, COOL!

exchanges.tamer: It'd be even better if you took care of it.
exchanges.digimon: Took... care? Me, never think about that... Me, study...

exchanges.tamer: Want me to polish it for you?
exchanges.digimon: Yes! Me, grateful. You, good person.
Me, too? Not just blade...? You, say nice things.

entries.opening: Make me sound cool when you talk to me.

exchanges.digimon: You keeping talking to me like that, and I bet I can really cut loose!

exchanges.tamer: Good day to you, Brave WaruSeadramon!
exchanges.digimon:
Makes me sound like one of those wandering samurai types. 
Yeah, it's got a ring to it.
Sounds very... friendly. Yup, I like it.

"Li'l" is the total opposite of cool! It's cute, even! Still... 
Not so bad, I guess.

entries.opening: Darkness... is... comforting...

exchanges.tamer: Let's go for a stroll in the sunlight.
exchanges.digimon: I do not like it... yet it may be interesting to attempt.

exchanges.tamer: Where does darkness come from, I wonder...
exchanges.digimon:
A fair question to ask. As to the answer... Seek that for
yourself.

exchanges.tamer: Let's go for a nighttime stroll, then.
exchanges.digimon:
You choose darkness as I have? Hmm. Perhaps it would not
hurt to join you this once.

exchanges.tamer: You're easy to find even in the dark.
exchanges.digimon:
Finding me in the gloom is no easy task... except, perhaps,
for you...

entries.opening: I want to live the slow life on a river with clean waters.

exchanges.tamer: Why don't we go look for that river of yours?
exchanges.digimon: That sounds like a great time! I might actually take you up on that.

exchanges.tamer: Let's study how to clean up the rivers, then.
exchanges.digimon:
Oh! We can make rivers clean again with our own hands? 
I really like that idea.

exchanges.tamer: We can clean up the rivers together.
exchanges.digimon:
It might take some time, but a little river cleanup could be fun 
if we take it slow.

exchanges.tamer: I'd protect a river where you could live.
exchanges.digimon: I get the feeling you'd really do it, too! You've got my trust.

entries.opening: I want to take over the vast oceans, rampaging wherever I please.

exchanges.tamer: You could do it right now, if you wanted.
exchanges.digimon:
Yes. If I felt like it, I'd rule over all the seas. Shall I show you 
how I'd do it?

exchanges.tamer: There are all kinds of seas around the world.
exchanges.digimon:
True. And different seas require different methods of attack. 
I should do some research.

You want to see my glorious romp through the seas? Hmm. 
I'll take you along someday...

exchanges.tamer: I bet you look beautiful when you swim.
exchanges.digimon:
You understand well. Yes, my true beauty is on full display 
when I'm in the ocean waves.

entries.opening: Allow me to hear your ambitions.

exchanges.digimon:
Trek across this wide world, would you? That is a fine ambition, 
nay, a fine dream.

You are greedier for knowledge than I ever imagined. Such 
hunger pleases me.

exchanges.tamer: Helping you out with your ambition.
exchanges.digimon:
My ambition... That is greater strength. Perhaps with you, 
I could pursue this goal.

exchanges.tamer: Being with you forever and ever.
exchanges.digimon:
Hmph. If that is your wish, very well. Not that I condemn such
an aim.

entries.opening: How can everyone live in peace, I wonder...

exchanges.tamer: By having the courage to talk to each other.
exchanges.digimon:
Courage... I'm sure I'm lacking that. I feel like I can get some 
by sticking around you, though!

You're right. It's hard to be together, much less talk, if you lack 
empathy and insight.

exchanges.tamer: Let's think of a way together.
exchanges.digimon:
Having you to depend on really puts me at ease. Let's keep on 
keeping on, together!

exchanges.tamer: With love, peace is sure to follow.
exchanges.digimon:
Yeah. No matter what, I'll keep love and hope in my heart... 
especially for you!

entries.opening: *crash* *boom* Me, shiny, buff body! Me, super cool!

exchanges.digimon:
Hehehe... Me hoped you say that. Me wanna join human 
bodybuildin' competition!
Me, brawn AND brains! Lookit me go! *crash* *bang*

You want me train you, too? We get real tough. JumboGamemon 
guarantee!

Me, heart shine, but nobody else see... But you! You see. Me, 
take shine to YOU!

entries.opening: Googoo, gaga!

exchanges.digimon:
If that's what ya think, then put your dukes up! Googoo! 
I'm comin' for ya! Gaga!

If that's what ya think, then feed me! Googoo!
Figure out what I wanna eat! Gaga!

You guessed it, so now ya gotta babble with me! Googoo! 
C'mon! Let's sing! Gaga!

You guessed it, so now ya gotta say, "Pain, pain, go away!"
Googoo!

entries.opening: Isn't the flower on my head just darling?

exchanges.tamer: I've never seen anything like it.
exchanges.digimon:
I'll Digivolve into a form that's just as pretty as your world's 
flowers. You'll see!

Hmm. I guess it kind of looks like one, huh? It's as odd as 
it is beautiful!

I know it's yellow, but that's just the way it looks. No need to
fret. Honest!

Why, any name you like. I can't wait to hear what lovely label 
you come up with!

entries.opening: Want me to try puffing up my body?

exchanges.digimon:
Don't just watch me! If you like what you see, then let's fight
together!
Humans seem to get a kick out of it. Take a gander anytime!
Come on, no need to be so uptight! I'm ready to go anytime!

Far from it. It actually feels pretty good. Let's puff up together
someday!

entries.opening: Look! Look! My seedling is sprouting!

exchanges.tamer: It's looking a bit dry, actually.
exchanges.digimon:
How rude. Far from being dry, it's full of vitality! You'd do well 
to learn from it!

Couldn't say for sure, but I bet it will. Keep a real close eye on it 
for me, okay?

exchanges.tamer: What kind of seedling is it?
exchanges.digimon:
Couldn't tell you, but I'm sure it'll be key to my Digivolution! 
Keep a close eye on me!

Aw, how kind! Still, don't worry. I'm sure I'll Digivolve beautifully 
no matter what!

entries.opening: I wonder what lies beyond the skies...

exchanges.digimon:
Ooh! Let's go on an adventure! Just thinking about it gets 
me all atwitter!

I see! Yeah, could be! I want to learn about all kinds of things 
I don't know yet!

Hee hee! I bet you're right! New friends, wait for me! I'll be 
there someday soon!

Okay! Hey, can we hold hands? When I'm with you, I feel like 
I could soar!

entries.opening: The good ol' sol is nice and toasty! Sooo soothin'!

exchanges.digimon: Yer rarin' to go, ain't ya? Ya even got me in a tizzy over here!

I'm referrin' to the sun, pal. Hehe. This dome of mine ain't just 
for show, ya know!

exchanges.tamer: Makes you wanna take a nap, huh?
exchanges.digimon:
Yup, totally... *yawn* How's about you and me take a nice little 
siesta next time?

exchanges.tamer: Since it's so soothing, why not take a break?
exchanges.digimon: Nah, I'm good. Though I appreciate ya lookin' out for me, pal.

entries.opening: Hey there. Anything I can bee of help with?

exchanges.tamer: Well, could you carry this stuff?
exchanges.digimon: Sure, leave it to me! I'm good at carrying things!

exchanges.tamer: What kind of flower is that?
exchanges.digimon: Let's see... Hmm, I don't know! But I'll check around and find out!
Huh? But I can't... beecause we're already friends, right?

exchanges.tamer: You help enough just by being here.
exchanges.digimon: Haha! You're so silly. But thanks. I'll always BEE here for you!

entries.opening: I'm a little thirsty...

exchanges.digimon: Okay, time to be tough...! *panting* Now I'm even more thirsty.

exchanges.tamer: Sipping water slowly hydrates you better.
exchanges.digimon: Really? I wish I knew all kinds of stuff like you do.
Then can we take a break? I'm gonna dry up at this rate.

exchanges.tamer: You can have some of my water.
exchanges.digimon: Th-Thanks... I'll savor every drop.

entries.opening: What kind of prank should I pull next?

exchanges.tamer: If you're gonna prank, then prank fair!
exchanges.digimon:
The heck does that even mean? Though, hmm... Maybe you're 
onto something there.

exchanges.tamer: What kind of pranks have you pulled so far?
exchanges.digimon: You wanna know? Then lemme give you the rundown.

exchanges.tamer: Wanna have a strategy session about it?
exchanges.digimon: Hehehe. Oh, you're baaad! I dig it. Let's give it a nice, long think.

exchanges.tamer: You can prank me, but only me.
exchanges.digimon:
How weird, wanting to get pranked. But if you insist, I'll 
go crazy with it.

entries.opening: What would you do if you met someone in trouble?

exchanges.digimon: Wonderful! I feel I would do the same.

Indeed, if we knew the cause, then perhaps we could do
something to help.

exchanges.tamer: I'd try and cheer them up.
exchanges.digimon:
We all get troubled from time to time. It is no wonder you
would like to comfort them.

S-Such extreme measures...! Still, I suppose that would most
easily convey your intent...

entries.opening: I picked a bunch of fruit! What color do you wanna eat?

exchanges.tamer: The red one looks like it'll perk me up!
exchanges.digimon: Nice! The spicy red one! I bet you'll be breathing fire in no time!

exchanges.tamer: I wonder how the dark purple one tastes.
exchanges.digimon:
It sure is a weird color. Never tried it, myself. I always wondered 
what it tastes like.

exchanges.tamer: Let's eat the yellow one together.
exchanges.digimon:
It's tasty, but that peel is no joke. Let's try and split that bad boy 
open together!

exchanges.tamer: I'll have the pink, spongy one.
exchanges.digimon: This fruit's real, real easy to bruise. Handle it gently, okay?

entries.opening: Say, what do ya wanna do when ya grow up?

exchanges.tamer: I wanna try all sorts of challenges!
exchanges.digimon: Yeah, hard to choose just one, huh? Best to have lots of dreams!

exchanges.tamer: I wanna learn all kinds of things!
exchanges.digimon: I see! I got plenty to learn, too. I oughta follow yer example!

exchanges.tamer: I wanna make all sorts of friends!
exchanges.digimon:
A buncha friends, huh? Sure would be nice. Of course, you and 
me are already friends!

exchanges.tamer: I wanna be with you, even when we're all grown up!
exchanges.digimon:
...Heck yeah–and ya will! No matter what happens, we'll
always be pals!

entries.opening: La laaa, la la laaaaa! ♪

exchanges.digimon:
Oh, yes! I committed the bravery inside of me to song. 
I'm glad it resonated with you!

I committed the quizzical, inquisitive nature within me 
to song. La la laaa! ♪

It's my song of friendship! A tune to say everyone should 
have fun together!

Hoho. Not even close. But if you want one so badly, I'd be 
happy to croon to you gently.

entries.opening: I wonder... How do you find my performance?

exchanges.digimon: You are too kind. I will continue to give you my best efforts!

exchanges.tamer: Your intelligence is a huge help.
exchanges.digimon:
I am honored to be of service. I will continue to hone 
my mental prowess!

Why, thank you! Having you think of me as an equal is a 
great honor!
...Thank you. I value you as well.

entries.opening: Ain't nothing out there that can spook me! No way!

exchanges.digimon: Ugh... N-Nope, not scared! I can... I can knock it right back!

exchanges.tamer: It's important to know your weak points.
exchanges.digimon: Y-You think so? Maybe you're right... Guess I got a lot to learn.

exchanges.tamer: Together, the two of us are untouchable!
exchanges.digimon: Exactly! Nobody can get in the way of our friendship!

exchanges.tamer: So, what out there delights you?
exchanges.digimon: Huh. Never even thought about it. I wonder...

entries.opening: Tell me. What I need to live long?

exchanges.digimon:
Courage... No understand the heart. But my chest... warm. 
This, courage?
Knowledge... I lack. That why I so curious, I think.
Help each other... Taught me, you did. So important... friends are.
Love... That hard. Teach me more. Me, still much to learn.

entries.opening: The idea someone could attack me at any time freaks me out...!

exchanges.digimon:
O-Okay... I guess I have gotten tougher. If they hit me, I'll hit 
them right back!

exchanges.tamer: Why don't you think of a way to escape?
exchanges.digimon: You're right. I'll think up all sorts of ways to flee if I get scared!

Sure. I don't like fighting, anyway. I just hope everyone's friendly 
like you...
Okay... Thanks a bunch! I sure am lucky to have a pal like you!

entries.opening:
I'll play a tune to liven things up, glurp. Got any requests,
glurp?

exchanges.digimon:
You got it, glurp! Just hearing this song'll get those heroic
juices flowing, glurp!

That could be a tough one, glurp... But nothing's impossible
for me, glurp!

Leave it to me, glurp! I've got a good-vibes number that'll get 
everybody dancing, glurp!

Say no more, glurp! There won't be a dry eye around once this 
tearjerker starts, glurp!

entries.opening: You and me, staring contest! First to smile loses!

exchanges.tamer: Grr, I'm gonna mug at you good!
exchanges.digimon: Ngh! Two can play at that game. Arrrrr!
That sounds... pretty smart, actually. You mean, like this?

exchanges.tamer: Get a load of this funny face!
exchanges.digimon:
Oh, boy. That's a good one. I appreciate you coming at 
this so seriously.

exchanges.tamer: Aww, what a cutie you are.
exchanges.digimon:
Ack, you made me smile! It's my loss... Still, not a bad way 
to go out. No, indeed!

entries.opening: Kehehe. I'm bored! Tell me a good story!

exchanges.tamer: Okay, here's one about fighting monsters.
exchanges.digimon:
Whoa, that Momotaro guy's awesome! Now I'm all fired up!
Kehe!

exchanges.tamer: Okay, the one about the treasure box.
exchanges.digimon:
So unfair that Urashima Taro got all old just for helping that
turtle! I wanna know why!

exchanges.tamer: How about "The Monkey and the Crab"?
exchanges.digimon:
So even little crabs and their friends can beat a monkey 
if they work together!

exchanges.tamer: How about "The Tale of Princess Kaguya"?
exchanges.digimon:
So sad she went back to the moon and left those old folks 
behind... *sniffle*

entries.opening:
Halt! Who goes there?! Ah... Sorry. Just a habit from my
patrols.

exchanges.digimon:
That makes all of my vigilance worthwhile. I'll take down any 
suspicious parties!

Why, you ask...? Force of habit, I guess. I should think for
myself a little more.

exchanges.tamer: I'll leave it to you to keep watch.
exchanges.digimon:
Yes, as you should. I'll have you watch my back in return,
partner.

exchanges.tamer: Thanks for all your hard work.
exchanges.digimon:
The acknowledgment is appreciated. After all... it's you I'm 
working hard to protect.

entries.opening: There's no sun at night, so it's a little boring.

exchanges.tamer: We could try spooking each other for fun.
exchanges.digimon: You mean, like a test of courage? Wow... You must be pretty brave.

exchanges.tamer: Why not turn on some lights?
exchanges.digimon:
Oh, yeah. I didn't think of that! You're a smart cookie. 
I could learn a thing or two.

exchanges.tamer: It'd be a blast to hang out together.
exchanges.digimon: Really? You mean, like, tonight? I'm in!

exchanges.tamer: Just sleep. We'll pick this up tomorrow...
exchanges.digimon:
Yep, that's the best idea! Let's grab some sleep, and regroup 
in the morning!

entries.opening: Bzz... How do you like my wings?

exchanges.digimon:
Bzz! Right? I'll show you how I use them to fly around and take
out foes!

exchanges.tamer: I wanna study them more closely.
exchanges.digimon:
More curious than you are scared, huh? All right. Get as close
a look as you want.

Scared, huh? Bzz. How honest of ya. But relax. I'd never hurt
a partner.

Cute...? Now, that really throws me off. But... I guess not
necessarily in a bad way.

entries.opening: I'm the guardian of justice and order in the world!

exchanges.tamer: Sorry for causing so much trouble.
exchanges.digimon:
If you feel that way, then mend your ways. Now, and without
troubling me further.

exchanges.tamer: Are you sure things aren't a little chaotic?
exchanges.digimon:
That's how it appears to you, is it? Still, this bears looking into
on my end as well.

Of course. It's my duty, after all. However, as my companion,
you'll be assisting me, too.

That sentiment is most welcome. I'm certain there is much you
can do.

entries.opening: These parts of mine remind you of anything?

exchanges.digimon:
No powers of observation, huh? Focus on your friends and you'll 
see all kinds of things.

Good catch. You can have the data I get from this radar and 
head-mounted display anytime.

The wings do stand out, huh? They let me glide freely, arriving 
safely by your side.

Splendid, yes? I can bound into the air even without wings, so
I can protect you anywhere.

entries.opening: I have a question. What is it you wish to protect?

exchanges.digimon: Ah, so you have convictions, do you? I wish I were like you!

Without memories, everything you have been up to now would 
disappear... A scary thought.
You are such a caring person. Let us protect our friends together!
...Wh-Why, thank you. I would like to keep you safe as well.

entries.opening:
I'm thinking of writing a new song. What kind of music should
I do?

exchanges.digimon: Rock! I like that! My fiery heart is gonna set ya ablaze!
Classical! Sounds tough, but I like a good challenge!
Love to all my homies out there! The rap master is in the house!

Hey, a follow-up could work! Everybody's gonna get a dose 
of heartbreak!

entries.opening: I sang too much, and got a frog in my throat, glurp...

exchanges.digimon:
This isn't enough to deter me, glurp! A little break, and I'll 
be back at it, glurp!

exchanges.tamer: It's just because the air is so dry.
exchanges.digimon:
I wouldn't have opened up the pipes if I'd known, glurp. 
Tell a 'mon beforehand, glurp!

exchanges.tamer: Well, you did sleep with your mouth open...
exchanges.digimon:
How rude, glurp! At least my snoring sounds better than 
those Gekomon, glurp!

But my fans are always waiting to hear me croon, glurp! 
I can't let them down, glurp!

entries.opening: What do you think is inside this thicket on my back?

exchanges.digimon:
Yes, that is correct! True royalty meets force with force and 
never yields!

Qu-Quite right. Royalty must be wise... and I must do a little
reading.

Precisely. It is the duty of the nobility to aid those less
fortunate!

Indeed. Sad love sonnets penned each night as I— Wait. 
What rubbish have you got me saying?

entries.opening: I ask that you protect and treasure the deep green forest.

exchanges.tamer: It's dangerous deep in the forest.
exchanges.digimon:
I would never put friends in danger, yet who knows what awaits 
those who tread carelessly?

I am heartened by your knowledge on the subject. As long as 
it is not to excess.

exchanges.tamer: I'll help any way I can.
exchanges.digimon:
I do not require much. Simply leave nature to her course and 
she will provide.

exchanges.tamer: I promise to cherish the forest.
exchanges.digimon:
I would be thrilled if everyone thought that way. Watch over it, 
at a proper distance.

entries.opening: Every beautiful flower has its poison, you know.

exchanges.tamer: A little poison doesn't scare me.
exchanges.digimon:
I wouldn't be so flippant, if I were you. Careful not to let 
beauty lead you astray.

That may be true as well. If you're putting in that much thought, 
I guess you'll be fine.

exchanges.tamer: Fine by me, as long as it's pretty.
exchanges.digimon:
Forgive me if I don't agree. Here's to hoping that sentiment 
never comes back to bite you.

Aren't you the careful sort? That's actually a relief to hear. 
I want to keep you around.

entries.opening: Say, how do I look from your perspective?

exchanges.digimon: That's because you keep me bright-eyed and bushy-tailed!

Hee hee. You have no idea what a fine specimen of maturity 
I've become.
My! You really do understand me, don't you?
Thanks! And I hope you'll come to rely on me more and more.

entries.opening: A strong heart dwells within a strong body!

exchanges.tamer: A strong heart is more important.
exchanges.digimon:
Without a strong heart, one falls prey to cowardice. You are
right about that.

True. One cannot prevail without a strong body. Utilize your
mind, certainly, but train your body first.
I am envious! I should follow your example.

exchanges.tamer: It's best to have at least one.
exchanges.digimon:
Agreed. Or you could have one, and your friend the other. It
would be most unfortunate not to have either.

entries.opening: What's this? Were you looking it me, by any chance?

exchanges.tamer: I was captivated by your beauty.
exchanges.digimon:
I can hardly blame you. Go on, then. Feast your eyes until 
you're satiated.

exchanges.tamer: I was wondering how you got so gorgeous.
exchanges.digimon: It must all be thanks to my desire to remain ravishing at all times.

Infatuated with my eternal beauty, are you? I will stay 
by your side forever.

exchanges.tamer: I was looking because I like you.
exchanges.digimon:
I can accept your feelings, but be ready to be ever captivated 
by me, body and soul.

entries.opening: Just so you know, I'm a bit of a fibber.

exchanges.tamer: Even I tell a lie or two sometimes.
exchanges.digimon:
My lies aren't so trite! Anyway, don't come crying to me if you 
end up feeling taken in.
Urgh, touché. You win this round...

exchanges.tamer: You ought to quit all that.
exchanges.digimon: You're right. I'll never, ever lie again— Whoopsie! I done dood it again.

Okey-dokey. I'll lie so good you won't even know you're 
being hoodwinked.

entries.opening: You may leave the shuriken work to me!

exchanges.tamer: Go on. Give one a throw, then.
exchanges.digimon:
I fear I must refuse. My shuriken always find their mark. 
I shall not take a life this day.

exchanges.tamer: Teach me how to throw them!
exchanges.digimon:
It will not do much good if you cannot extend your limbs like I can. 
Still, observe!

exchanges.tamer: Lend me one of your shuriken.
exchanges.digimon:
These shuriken are my life. Even if I trust in you, I cannot hand
them over so readily.

exchanges.tamer: Okay. I'll leave it to you.
exchanges.digimon:
Very good. I vow on these shuriken I shall protect my comrades 
until my last breath!

entries.opening: What aspect of mine makes me seem the toughest?

exchanges.tamer: Those big, ol' pincers of yours.
exchanges.digimon:
Hehehe. I thought as much. I'm always itching to pinch 
something with them.

You think? I'm more of a "charge in first, ask questions 
later" kind of 'mon.

exchanges.tamer: The way you keep foes away from your allies.
exchanges.digimon: True. Hiding behind me is one of the safest places to be.

To protect what needs to be protected, you need a heart 
that's stronger than anything.

entries.opening: I am the Monarch of the Insects!

exchanges.digimon:
Bow in veneration to the glory of my impenetrable 
Chrondigizoid shell.

exchanges.tamer: So you control Insectoid Digimon directly?
exchanges.digimon: Remember this! A monarch never handles such matters personally.

Of course. You should be honored to count such a valiant warrior 
among your friends.

exchanges.tamer: That's what I love about you.
exchanges.digimon: A monarch is beloved by all.

entries.opening: Is the aura I emit too bright for you?

exchanges.tamer: Yes, but I'll try to handle it...!
exchanges.digimon:
No need to force yourself. I shall invite you to a blessed world of 
illusion all the same.

exchanges.tamer: Where does that aura come from?
exchanges.digimon:
My power, one which bestows peaceful dreams that allow you 
to forget your cares.

exchanges.tamer: Give me some of that sheen, why don't you?
exchanges.digimon: Take as much as you like. All I desire is your happiness.

exchanges.tamer: I can't get enough of that gleam.
exchanges.digimon:
I am glad. Continue to gaze upon me, and I shall grant all the 
happy dreams you like.

entries.opening: Even if it's hot and bright, I love me some strong sunshine!

exchanges.digimon:
Yeah, of course! The more Mister Sun shines down on us, 
the better we'll be!

exchanges.tamer: Sure helps with the photosynthesis, I bet.
exchanges.digimon: Uh-huh. And I hope I make you tons of fresh oxygen to breathe!

Never you fear about me. Just make sure not to get too much 
direct sunlight yourself.

exchanges.tamer: Not loving the idea of a sunburn.
exchanges.digimon:
You may dread the thought, but not me. All that sun makes 
for some fine photosynthesis!

entries.opening: Love or beauty, which do you desire?

exchanges.digimon:
Surely that is nothing more than bravado. One can't live with 
neither love nor beauty.

First, think long and hard about what you need to fulfill that 
insatiable desire.
Then I will give it to you—in exchange for your love.
Then I will give it to you—in exchange for your beauty.

entries.opening: Gigigi! Gigigigi!

exchanges.tamer: Wait. Does that mean you wanna fight?
exchanges.digimon:
Gigigi... While I do like cutting loose sometimes, I've got no beef 
with you.

exchanges.tamer: Isn't that a different sound from usual?
exchanges.digimon:
Gigigi... Good for you for noticing. But I just need some exercise, 
so I was stretching.

Gigigi! Is that how I look to you? I'm full of vim and vigor, let me 
tell you!

exchanges.tamer: Are you all right? Pull yourself together!
exchanges.digimon:
Gigi, gigigi... I was, uh, just fixing my posture, is all. Sorry to 
worry you.

entries.opening: What should we do for fun today?

exchanges.digimon: Fine with me, but it's gonna hurt if you fall!
I'm sick of rocks and boulders, but if you wanna do it, then let's go!
Okay, but you're it!
...Oh, I was just thinkin' that'd be fun, too.

entries.opening: I'm hungry.

exchanges.tamer: Eating too much is bad for you.
exchanges.digimon: Mind your own business!
And quantity is better than quality.
That'd be great!
Now you're talkin'! You know what I like.

entries.opening: You all had better appreciate the electricity you got.

exchanges.tamer: Back at you! Watch what you discharge!
exchanges.digimon: Oh! Yeah... I'll be careful.
I don't get it, but sounds awesome!
That's not really my specialty.

exchanges.tamer: I keep my energy consumption to a minimum.
exchanges.digimon: Glad to hear it. I'll do my part, too!

entries.opening: When it comes down to it, just leave the fighting to me.

exchanges.digimon:
Too good for me, huh? Still, you seem like someone I can
count on.

exchanges.tamer: Let's come up with a strategy first.
exchanges.digimon: That sounds good. I'm big on planning, myself.

exchanges.tamer: When it's time to fight, we fight together.
exchanges.digimon: Suit yourself, then.
Back at you.

entries.opening: Dagnabbit! I'm just itching to run wild!

exchanges.tamer: Want me to take you on?
exchanges.digimon: You're on! ...Hah! As if! Why would I ever throw down with you?!

exchanges.tamer: You should prepare for your next fight.
exchanges.digimon:
Hey, I'm more than good to go, you know! Battle ready, 
any day of the week!

exchanges.tamer: I bet that's driving you crazy, huh?
exchanges.digimon: I want to find someplace with a battle raging. Anywhere will do!

exchanges.tamer: You deserve to relax a little more.
exchanges.digimon: Nice of you to say, but relaxing just gets me ready to snooze...

entries.opening: Why's everyone always trying to fight?

exchanges.digimon: In that case, why don't they just arm wrestle or something?
In that case, why don't they just work out or something?
Welp, nothing I can say about that, then.
In that case, why don't they just let me be their friend?

entries.opening: I'm the hardest and heaviest of 'em all!

exchanges.tamer: Don't you think you eat too much?
exchanges.digimon:
Can't get a bod like mine by sweatin' that stuff!
I chow down all I want!

exchanges.tamer: Do you have trouble moving around?
exchanges.digimon: I can charge and jump with the best of 'em! Watch and learn, kid!

exchanges.tamer: Maybe you should lose some weight.
exchanges.digimon: Don't you worry. I'm at my bulky best!
Just you wait till I Digivolve. Then I'll be even cooler!

entries.opening: You got any time to spare?

exchanges.tamer: I don't have any to give.
exchanges.digimon:
You seem like a stickler when it comes to time. But that's not
a bad thing.

exchanges.tamer: I do if you pay me back later.
exchanges.digimon: You're really on top of it. I like people who value their time.

exchanges.tamer: Let's both make time for each other.
exchanges.digimon:
When you say it like that, it sounds like I'll need to give some
of my time, too.

exchanges.tamer: I'll always make time for the two of us.
exchanges.digimon:
Well, what a nice thing to say. I'll give you my time, too,
someday.

entries.opening: I want to be big. I mean REAL big!

exchanges.tamer: Small and strong is good enough, isn't it?
exchanges.digimon:
I'd love to be big and strong, but I guess I can start with the 
"strong" part!

exchanges.tamer: Big is just easier for enemies to spot.
exchanges.digimon: Huh! I guess you're right! I'm glad I'm a shrimp!

exchanges.tamer: Your size is part of the Mamemon charm!
exchanges.digimon:
Huh. I guess I wouldn't be the Mamemon you all know and love 
if I were big, would I?
Y-You really think so? Hehe!

entries.opening: I'm 90% machine now. Isn't that cool?!

exchanges.tamer: Depends on how strong you are.
exchanges.digimon:
My strength is nothing to sneeze at, of course. I want to show 
you how cool I can be!

Then I'm plenty cool! My Energy Bomb has awesome destructive
power!
You can take a closer look, if you want!

exchanges.tamer: You're cool, with or without machinery.
exchanges.digimon:
Really? You mean, like, cool on the inside?! That makes me
so happy!

entries.opening: ALL WHO STAND IN OUR PATH SHALL BE ELIMINATED.

exchanges.digimon: LEAVE THE REST UP TO ME.
"OVERDOING IT" IS NOT PART OF MY PROGRAMMING.

exchanges.tamer: Sometimes it's important to talk things out.
exchanges.digimon: I WILL LEAVE THOSE SITUATIONS TO YOU.
...I WILL TRY.

entries.opening: Will there be any chance to use my Atomic Ray?

exchanges.tamer: Sure. Keep it always ready to fire.
exchanges.digimon: Understood. I will be ready to fight anytime!

exchanges.tamer: I'd like to avoid it, if possible.
exchanges.digimon: In that case, I shall simply judge by the flow of each battle.

exchanges.tamer: Sure, when it's time to help our allies.
exchanges.digimon: Understood. I shall protect our allies to the end!

exchanges.tamer: Sure, when it's time to save our loved ones.
exchanges.digimon: Understood. You are the only one I would consider a loved one.

entries.opening: DO YOU WANT TO SEE AN EXAMPLE OF UNLIMITED STRENGTH?

exchanges.tamer: Sure! I wanna see unlimited strength.
exchanges.digimon: THEN LOOK IN FRONT OF YOU. I AM THAT EXAMPLE.

exchanges.tamer: Is it you? What makes you so strong?
exchanges.digimon:
I HAVE THE STRONGEST PARTS, DIGICORE AND PROGRAMMING. 
THEY GRANT ME INFINITE POWER.

IF YOU ACCEPT ME, I WILL ALWAYS OFFER YOU MY 
UNWAVERING SUPPORT.
IF YOU ASK IT OF ME, I SHALL PROVIDE IT FOREVERMORE.

entries.opening: Leave any aerial assaults to me.

exchanges.digimon:
Just fly? I bet the idea of fighting will pique your interest once 
you are up there.

exchanges.tamer: How can you fly with such a huge body?
exchanges.digimon:
The vernier thrusters on my shoulders. I doubt anyone but me 
could control this power.

No need for you to lift a finger. I have more than enough power 
on my own.

exchanges.tamer: I won't let you do anything reckless.
exchanges.digimon:
Your concern is unwarranted. The power within me is much 
greater than you think.

entries.opening: I'm the most gargantuan Digimon on land.

exchanges.tamer: Your bulk is a little intimidating.
exchanges.digimon: No need to fear me, but do be careful not to get trampled underfoot.

exchanges.tamer: How did you even get that huge?
exchanges.digimon:
Repeated remodeling, I suppose? In any case, reaching my
size would probably be impossible for most.

exchanges.tamer: I want you to get even bigger.
exchanges.digimon:
I'd have trouble moving if I got bigger, but, with your 
support, maybe I could pull it off.

exchanges.tamer: Let me ride on your back!
exchanges.digimon: Fine by me. Just don't scald yourself with my boosters, okay?

entries.opening: I'm on FIRE, baby!

exchanges.digimon: Nice! I like it! But be sure you don't get burned.
Why, me, of course! I can keep this fire burning forever and ever!
Heck, yeah! I'm a raging blaze!

Appreciate the thought! But this flame ain't even CLOSE to 
my max, pal!

entries.opening: Bloob, bloob!

exchanges.digimon: Sure! I'll do my best, too!
Teach me, too.
I'm counting on you, too!
Friends forever!

entries.opening: Puni, puniii!

exchanges.digimon: Together, with you!
Me, Punimon!
Me, good kid!
Me, so happy!

entries.opening: I wanna fight, too! Like, right now!

exchanges.tamer: I wanna send you into battle soon.
exchanges.digimon:
First, I've gotta Digivolve into a stronger form, right? I'll do my 
best, so cheer me on!

exchanges.tamer: You oughta watch some battles first.
exchanges.digimon:
I've been watching a whole bunch! I'm practically an expert 
at this point.
All right. If you say so! Boy, you're a kind person, aren't you!

exchanges.tamer: I don't wanna have you fight just yet.
exchanges.digimon:
Fine, then. I'll give up on the idea for now. You really know me 
pretty well, don't you!

entries.opening: Is my horn cool, or is my horn cool?!

exchanges.digimon:
Man, I must be pretty awesome if I can scare you. I'm gonna 
scare you some more!
Iffy? What do you mean by "iffy"? Come on! You can tell me!
What? It does?! That makes me pretty giddy! I'm not gonna lie.

Appreciate it! I ought to Digivolve real soon, so I can get even
cooler.

entries.opening:
If you wish to get stronger, I'd be more than happy to train you. 
What say you?

exchanges.digimon: That's the spirit! Learn all the techniques you can from me.
Training is the only way, I'm afraid. Still, strength isn't everything.

Yet training provides such unique insights! Perhaps even a way 
to read your opponent.
Well said. As long as those words aren't simply sour grapes.

entries.opening: I wanna do more for you.

exchanges.digimon: You're right. First, I've gotta get stronger and Digivolve!

exchanges.tamer: I don't wanna depend on others too much.
exchanges.digimon: You being so brave like that just makes me wanna help you more.

exchanges.tamer: Just you saying that is more than enough.
exchanges.digimon: I'm glad you and I are friends!
Okay, then I'm gonna keep going with my training, so just you watch!

entries.opening: Hey, how goes it?

exchanges.digimon: Okay, then time for another full-throttle day!

I shoulda known. I gotta stay more on top of my health game, 
like you!
Yeah, of course I can!
Gotta make sure to take breaks every now and then, huh?

entries.opening: Soaring through the sky feels amazing!

exchanges.digimon: If only you had wings like me, huh?
Huh? You've flown before? No way.

exchanges.tamer: Running on the ground feels great, too.
exchanges.digimon: Take me with you sometime!
Must be tough being human.

entries.opening: Which is faster, running or flying?

exchanges.digimon:
I feel the same way. I want to get good at both so I don't have to 
worry about choosing.

Okay, then take notes next time I run and next time I fly and 
let's compare.

I'd win a race against you... But just running together sounds like 
it'd be fun.

It seems that way since you can't fly, but slow is better when 
hanging out in the sky.

entries.opening: Not good enough! I gotta have more!

exchanges.tamer: What do you need more of?
exchanges.digimon: Power, speed and fighting spirit. Help me get into gear!

Don't try to console me. Or maybe you're trying to show me 
another tactic...?
Well, that really takes the wind outta my sails. You win.
You're gonna join me? I knew I could count on you!

entries.opening: Which color do you prefer, red, blue, yellow or green?

exchanges.digimon:
You like the shade of my legs? Some fear the hue thanks to
these sharp talons, but not you, no.

You like the tint of my crest? You must be intrigued by the 
lightning it shoots, too.

You like my wings' hue? If you can take it, I'll show you how 
they shine at sonic speed.

You like the tone of my body? I bet you hold the trees of the 
forest dear as well.

entries.opening: Check out these muscles!

exchanges.digimon: Only an adult could understand the value of muscles like these.

exchanges.tamer: I wish I had a body like yours.
exchanges.digimon: Then you'd better hit the gym, pal.

exchanges.tamer: Those sure are some awesome muscles!
exchanges.digimon: Drink them in. I don't mind.
...Just a little would be fine, I guess.

entries.opening: I'm gonna prank you good if you don't train properly!

exchanges.digimon: For real? I'm keeping my eye on you!
Amazing! Glad to hear it. I look forward to seeing the results!
You're slacking off! Look out, because I'm gonna prank you!

exchanges.tamer: If you're gonna prank me, then prank me.
exchanges.digimon: Hehehe... Oh, this is gonna be good.

entries.opening: C'mon. Let's play!

exchanges.digimon: But that's training! You really are serious about stuff, huh?
Okay, that works, too. I love listening to you!
I'm not very fast, but you'll never beat me!

Okay, then I'll be it. We could play hide and seek, but I know
I'd find you right away!

entries.opening: You wanna hear my song, or what?

exchanges.digimon:
All right! I'm gonna shout at full blast! Get ready, or I'll knock ya 
off your feet!

You want a nice li'l listening party, do ya? Okay, I'll burn my ditty 
into your brain.

exchanges.tamer: How about a song and a dance?
exchanges.digimon: If ya insist, then I'll put on a show! A live performance, just for you!

I won't lend ya the mic, but you can sing your heart out! This is
our harmony, baby!

entries.opening: Who would you say is a truly strong Digimon?

exchanges.digimon:
Nor could I, but if I keep on beating strong Digimon, I'm sure 
I'll figure it out someday.

exchanges.tamer: I wouldn't say it was you.
exchanges.digimon:
That's understandable. This world is full of Digimon I've never 
laid eyes on, after all.

Thank you. Having felled strong Digimon and copied their 
data, I am undoubtably strong.

exchanges.tamer: It could be practically any one of them.
exchanges.digimon:
I see. Well, no matter what strong Digimon I end up facing, 
I hope you will back me up.

entries.opening: Don't you like the cold?

exchanges.digimon:
Then you ought to train in the polar frost. You'll get used to it
for sure.
Just make sure you can still say that even in the arctic chill.

exchanges.tamer: I don't mind, as long as I've got my friends.
exchanges.digimon: I'm glad to hear that.

exchanges.tamer: It'd be nice if you'd keep me warm!
exchanges.digimon:
If you mean keeping warm with some warmups together, then 
I'd do it gladly.

entries.opening: I have confidence in my thrusters.

exchanges.digimon: This isn't exactly the best place to ignite my rocket engines...
Never you fear. I've got full control over them. You'll see.

exchanges.tamer: Can't wait to see what you can do with them.
exchanges.digimon:
I won't let you down. These rocket engines are like an extension 
of my own body.

I appreciate your concern. Looking forward to the chance to 
show them off!

entries.opening: No human is ever gonna tame me!

exchanges.tamer: Oh, I'm gonna. Just you wait.
exchanges.digimon: Tough talk. I look forward to seeing you try!
N-No, I'm not! Explain to me exactly how it is I'm tamed?

exchanges.tamer: I'd never think of trying to.
exchanges.digimon: Ha! I see you get it. You're in for lots of friendly pranks!

exchanges.tamer: I want you to tame me.
exchanges.digimon:
Wh-What the...? I didn't expect that. A tame human might not
be all that bad, though...

entries.opening: How awesome is my million-volt Electric Shock?

exchanges.digimon:
So Electric Shock is stronger, even though power lines are
way bigger then me? Wow!

Hey, so if I wanted to power my move with batteries, how
many would I need, huh? Huh?

exchanges.tamer: Lightning is one hundred million volts.
exchanges.digimon:
Whoa! Didn't know lightning was that amazing. I got a ways 
to go... Cheer me on, okay?

exchanges.tamer: An electrical outlet has one hundred volts.
exchanges.digimon:
So Electric Shock can't help around your house, huh? Don't
kick me out, though, okay?

entries.opening: I wanna go swimming.

exchanges.digimon: Then I'll teach you. Might be tough since you don't have fins, though.

I figured... But hopping around on land makes me tired, so
teach me how to move easier.

Uh, really? You do know nobody can beat me in the water, right? 
I'm not kidding!

I am, because I wanna hang out with you. It's just... 
everything's way easier in the water!

entries.opening: Have my claws gotten a little too long?

exchanges.digimon:
I haven't whipped out Slash Claw much these days. Better put
these bad boys to good use!
What? You sure? Guess it's hard to tell on my own. I'm glad I asked!

Must be my imagination, then. Okay! Now I feel like slashing 
something up!

Guess it doesn't matter in a scrap, huh? Still, I wish you paid 
closer attention...

entries.opening: Would you like me to give you a ride somewhere?

exchanges.tamer: Take me somewhere I've never been before.
exchanges.digimon:
You feel that much at ease with me, do you...? I'll 
consider it, then.

exchanges.tamer: I wanna go somewhere far away.
exchanges.digimon:
You and I have different ideas of what "far" is, so we should 
probably define that first.

Perhaps I was mistaken. But you should know that 
flying feels wonderful.

Well, if the day ever comes that you need my aid, all you need 
to do is ask.

entries.opening: Poyo, poyooo!

exchanges.digimon: Me, no lose!
Me, good 'mon!
Me, friend!
Me, love you, too!

entries.opening: I wanna Digivolve fast into something real tough!

exchanges.digimon: That's right! I chomp down on my foes real good!
Teach me, teach me, pretty please!

exchanges.tamer: You're nice and cute the way you are.
exchanges.digimon:
Really? Then maybe I won't Digivolve after all... Aw, but 
I really want to!

exchanges.tamer: You'd better get a cool look, too!
exchanges.digimon:
If my Digivolution makes me stronger, that's cool enough for me. 
Heck, I'm cool already!

entries.opening:
You have to apologize when you do something wrong, and 
apologize well... right?

exchanges.digimon:
...I knew it. I'd better work up the courage to apologize. 
Sorry for the weird question.

No! ...Well, okay, I guess I do have some regrets. Thanks for 
making me realize that.

exchanges.tamer: Did someone do something to you?
exchanges.digimon: No biggie. It's already over and done with. Sorry for worrying you.

You sure are nice, aren't you? In that case, I'll go ahead and 
forgive you.

entries.opening: Riding on a human's shoulders sure is relaxing!

exchanges.digimon:
That's just not true. Humans seem pleased to have me ride on 
them. You should try it.

I pick and choose my rides, thank you. Whether I'll ride you is 
still up in the air.

exchanges.tamer: Hop on up, then. I'll give you a ride.
exchanges.digimon:
I appreciate the thought. Still, I need to get to know you better, 
or I can't relax.

exchanges.tamer: Why not sit on their lap?
exchanges.digimon:
That's hardly the same, now, is it? I prefer the sensation of 
moving around with humans.

entries.opening: Say, what's a "puppy"?

exchanges.digimon:
Aw, what a shame! People say I look like one. If I ever spot one, 
I'm going to scold it!

exchanges.tamer: A lifeform that looks like you.
exchanges.digimon: Humans say that a lot, yeah. I'm real curious to know what they're like!

People say I look like one. I guess that's why humans are 
always so nice to me!

exchanges.tamer: A creature that's cute as a button!
exchanges.digimon:
Cute?! I'm told I look like one a lot, you know. What a nice 
thing to say!

entries.opening: We ought to take things more easy-breezy.

exchanges.tamer: I'd say we need to get more serious.
exchanges.digimon:
You're something else, aren't you? Still, don't go wearing yourself
out, now.

Not from where I'm standing, but if you say so. I'll try to follow 
your example.

exchanges.tamer: A little earnestness never hurt anyone.
exchanges.digimon:
Ease and earnestness are two sides of the same coin, y'know? 
I'm the perfect example.

exchanges.tamer: Aren't you a little too easy-going?
exchanges.digimon:
Too much is just right for yours truly. You really know how to 
compliment a 'mon!

entries.opening: I'm... I'm not a crybaby, you know!

exchanges.tamer: You're the dictionary definition of one.
exchanges.digimon:
I told you I'm not, but you... You...! *sniff* I won't cry, darn it! 
You hear me?!

exchanges.tamer: Only crybabies say they're not crybabies.
exchanges.digimon:
I see. So that's how it is... I'll strike the word from my vocabulary, 
then, starting now!

Okay. I won't cry... I'm not crying right now, am I? That means 
I'm cured! Right?

exchanges.tamer: Who said you were a crybaby?
exchanges.digimon:
Thanks for believing me! I bet no one'd call me that if you'd 
been around from the get-go.

entries.opening: I will not allow even the smallest of misdeeds to go unpunished.

exchanges.digimon:
I applaud you for having the courage to confess. However, 
never do it again.

exchanges.tamer: Can't you give me a pass?
exchanges.digimon:
If you can exercise guile, you should never have dabbled in 
wickedness to begin with.
...Please do not bother me with such banal antics.
And this is why you of all humans have my trust. Most admirable.

entries.opening:
Hey, pal! Where are you looking?! Over here! The tail is the 
one that's Reppamon!

exchanges.digimon:
Wrong! I'm the one that cuts and cleaves. The head is just 
spineless window dressing!

exchanges.tamer: The tail? Isn't that part just the blade?
exchanges.digimon:
That "just the blade" part you so glibly refer to is me, Reppamon! 
Get it straight!

exchanges.tamer: Whatever. It's all the same to me.
exchanges.digimon:
Look. I'm just a tail, with a body and head hanging off me 
like a tail. Get it?

exchanges.tamer: Aren't both of you Reppamon, a 2-in-1 deal?
exchanges.digimon:
Hey, if it were up to me, I'd just cut the other part off. 
But, sure. Have it your way.

entries.opening: I want you to make full use of the power of my Holy Ring.

exchanges.tamer: I'd rather not use it if I don't have to.
exchanges.digimon:
You probably wouldn't have to if things stay peaceful—but that's 
an even taller order.

exchanges.tamer: I wouldn't even know how to use it.
exchanges.digimon: Don't worry. I'll teach you the ins and outs of the whole thing.

exchanges.tamer: Thanks. I bet it'll be very useful.
exchanges.digimon: I'm glad! It's important to have each other's backs.

exchanges.tamer: Just make sure you don't lose it!
exchanges.digimon:
Thanks. But if things ever get dicey, I know you'll be there 
to protect me.

entries.opening: Let's travel around the world together!

exchanges.tamer: I wouldn't be able to keep up.
exchanges.digimon:
Don't be a scaredy-cat! Besides, I can help you if you fall
behind.

Not unassisted, no. But with the right knowledge, anything
is possible.

exchanges.tamer: I'd love to be able to fly.
exchanges.digimon:
Impossible without wings. Luckily, you have me to act as
your wings.

It isn't that simple. We can't let our excitement get the
better of us, here.

entries.opening: One must right the world's wrongs, condoning no evil.

exchanges.digimon:
I want you to be the nucleus of our efforts. Thus it is I who 
should be helping you.

If we each act thoughtfully and do good, the world will move 
in the right direction.

exchanges.tamer: I wanna be someone like that.
exchanges.digimon: Each like-minded ally I can muster makes the world a better place.

exchanges.tamer: I do that even when I'm by myself.
exchanges.digimon: I am here for you. I would never leave that burden to you alone.

entries.opening:
I walk the path of righteousness. Will you move forward
together with me on this path?

exchanges.tamer: I'm not sure I'm up to it.
exchanges.digimon:
In that case, I insist we walk it together. You can start by
overcoming your own fears.

If your determination is set, the path ahead shall open. Then
shall the learning begin!

That is what it means to be with me. I am pleased to see you 
understand as much.

exchanges.tamer: I'd like you to follow me, actually.
exchanges.digimon:
I had hoped you would take the lead one day. I am pleased that 
today is that day.

entries.opening: I pledge my fealty to you, my liege.

exchanges.tamer: So if I told you to die for me, you'd do it?
exchanges.digimon:
My loyalty to you stems from faith that you would never bid me 
do something so egregious.

exchanges.tamer: You'll obey my command without question?
exchanges.digimon:
Your orders are absolute. Please guide me, so that I may never 
stray from the path.

exchanges.tamer: You and I should be on equal footing.
exchanges.digimon: I must be devoted to my liege. I have no desire to rise to your station.

exchanges.tamer: I hope you come to like me.
exchanges.digimon:
But of course! And I hope my obedience is proof enough of 
that pledge.

entries.opening: I would never condone pointless killing!

exchanges.tamer: What exactly would you do about it?
exchanges.digimon: I would enact punishment! And do not think to interfere!

exchanges.tamer: But you would if there were a point to it?
exchanges.digimon:
Killing never has a point! All life in the Digital World must be 
met with compassion!
The offender must repent, and never take a life needlessly again.
Killing is born of conflict. We must aspire to a world free of strife.

entries.opening: Leave the vanguard to me.

exchanges.digimon:
I prefer to take the forefront myself, but for you, I can make 
an exception.
I look forward to seeing what strategy you devise.

When the Golden Meteor charges forth, you will witness swordplay
of unparalleled speed.

exchanges.tamer: Just don't lose it when you fight.
exchanges.digimon:
Is that sarcasm? My swordplay is on par with a Holy Knight, but
I will accept your advice.

entries.opening: You must remember to lock up everything.

exchanges.digimon:
I must safeguard the Zenith Gate. It is your responsibility to lock 
your own doors.

exchanges.tamer: I worry about forgetting to lock up.
exchanges.digimon:
Then you must always double-check. It is even better to confirm
it out loud.
That is wonderful. If it ever comes to it, we can help each other.

I can handle the security of the Zenith Gate alone. But I appreciate 
the thought.

entries.opening:
I am a Super Angel, one of three Celestial Digimon guarding 
the Digital World's Kernel.

exchanges.tamer: Can I help you in any way?
exchanges.digimon:
I would be happy if you spread word of my love and mercy 
throughout the Digital World.

My duty is to spread love and compassion throughout the 
Digital World. It is who I am.

One of the roles among angels, and a Digimon type, much like 
"Insectoid" or "Reptile."

exchanges.tamer: Is it okay for you to be here?
exchanges.digimon:
My presence here means there is something for me to observe, 
and to accomplish.

entries.opening: I am a Seraph Digimon, one who reigns over all Angel Digimon.

exchanges.tamer: Can I help you in any way?
exchanges.digimon: Do not allow evil to exist in this world.

I am of the highest Angel Digimon echelon, yet that is simply 
the role bestowed upon me.

The greatest of all angels, they say. That does not change 
the fact that we are friends.

exchanges.tamer: Is it okay for you to be here?
exchanges.digimon:
I leave this place when the final battle is nigh. Until then, 
I shall stay with you.

entries.opening:
Don't stand behind me. I won't be held responsible if you 
get a kick to the head.

exchanges.tamer: Kick me if you need to.
exchanges.digimon:
Talk about asking for it... You'll change your tune once you 
see my Rodeo Gallop.

exchanges.tamer: Would it really hurt that much?
exchanges.digimon:
"Hurt" wouldn't begin to describe it. Imagine it as a strike 
both brutal and true.

I would prefer you didn't without reason, but for the right cause 
I would acquiesce.

It's a reflex, I assure you. Though perhaps your special presence 
would negate it?

entries.opening: Allow me to enchant you with the light of my smile.

exchanges.digimon:
Such thoughts are proof of your impurity. One day, I shall 
purify you with my charm.
Wait. You cannot tell? One day, I shall purify you with my charm.
But of course. I have faith that you and I shall get along swimmingly.

Other humans said the same, but they, too, were mesmerized. 
As you shall be, I am sure.

entries.opening: Do you believe in miracles?

exchanges.digimon:
If there is any difficulty you wish to overcome, trust in me to 
see you through.

I sense hesitation within you. Stick with me, and one day 
you shall believe.

The power of miracles is real. You must never give up, no matter 
how hard the situation.

That is good to hear. To believe in me is to believe in the power 
of miracles.

entries.opening: Nobody's got more guts than me!

exchanges.tamer: What about stuff other than guts?
exchanges.digimon:
The sun is on my side, so my flames are unbeatable! Let's 
get out there and fight!

I know. It's always the guys with the least guts who say others 
don't have any.
Huh? But I wanted to be friends... We're in this together, right?
Thanks. So you respect me, huh? I respect you back.

entries.opening: Hmm? Did you say something just now?

exchanges.digimon:
I thought so! Figured you might be talking to someone else... 
Thanks! Let's do our best!

Yeah? Well, why not talk to me instead? I'm sure you've got 
tons to teach me.

I thought I heard your voice. My mistake. My hearing works 
against me sometimes...

I thought so. Appreciate it! I was confident I could pick out 
your voice. I'm glad I did!

entries.opening:
I have been chronicling all wisdom since the distant past. 
Nothing is beyond my knowledge.

exchanges.tamer: So do you know what I'm thinking right now?
exchanges.digimon:
That has nothing to do with wisdom. If you seek to test me, 
know that it is pointless.

I shall teach you what I can. To build the future, you must 
know the past.

The wisdom I possess can discern the future. I shall not apply 
that same scrutiny to you.

exchanges.tamer: Wish I could be like that.
exchanges.digimon:
Instead of wishing, I would have you learn from my wisdom 
and make it your own.

entries.opening: Gigigi! Gigigigi!

exchanges.digimon:
Gigigi... That's my hot DigiCore. Sorry for the stuffiness. Just
think of it as training!
Gigigi! I'm Solarmon, and don't you forget it!

Gigi? You saying I'm divine or something? Come on. You're
gonna make me blush...

exchanges.tamer: You're looking red in the face today.
